No Type F docket filed or decided in the last 90 days (since about 2026-08-04) was verified. New Jersey S4849 is already in skip/dockets.json.

The Senate NDAA version reportedly has no similar provision; not confirmed from a primary text.

FY2027 Energy and Water appropriations (H.R. 9022): House committee bill approved in May 2026 with $1.8B for DOE Office of Nuclear Energy and an IIJA reallocation (Sec. 313). Not written because the status after June 2026 could not be verified; the sponsor release and bill text were not fetched.

NRC Part 57 final-rule deadline of 2026-11-23 comes from search-result summaries (Glitchwire, Pillsbury), not a fetched primary page. No final Part 57 rule appeared in the Federal Register listing as of 2026-11-02.

NRC Part 57 proposed-rule comment deadline of 2026-06-15 and the Nuclear Innovation Alliance request for a 45-day extension: no fetched evidence that the NRC granted an extension. Not written as a check.

The FY2026 NRC fee rule's advanced-reactor hourly rate ($154, shipped in the ADVANCE Act record) could not be checked: the federalregister.gov document redirected to an unblock page and was not fetched.

The DOE Reactor Pilot Program, executive-order deadlines, Price-Anderson, 45Y/48E credits and state siting moratoria were not searched in this pass. Budget went to Part 57, NDAA, Janus, dockets and items.
New York PSC microreactor study: no 2026 PSC document found. Search results showed only 2014-era NYSERDA microgrid studies. Not written.
Army Janus updates after the 2026-08-26 awards: no October 2026 coverage found. Shipped news already carries the August awards.
Search quota: about 18 web searches and 10 fetches used, against a budget of about 25 searches and 20 fetches. The run stopped early after repeated empty results for the window.
